assumptions: object distance measured from lens along the axis

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: The stand-displacement sentences TE3BF, TAD1B and T1331 all state 15 cm, but TF673 (microphone stand) states 25 cm, so if TF673 is meant as a variant of a stand-displacement sentence it differs in the number, not only in attachment.

notes: Base: 1/v = 1/10 - 1/35 = 25/350, v = 14 cm (real). With the object's stand pushed 15 cm farther, u = 50 cm, 1/v = 1/10 - 1/50 = 4/50, v = 12.5 cm, still real. Object height (4 cm) affects image height via magnification but not image distance; I class it D for the asked quantity (it could be argued C as it belongs to the system, but it never enters the image-distance relation). T2924 and T97EB both state 4 cm and are consistent variants. TAD1B and T1331 are equivalent wordings (both 15 cm). TE3BF pairs with them at 15 cm. TF673 uses 25 cm; severity high is provisional, conditional on it being claimed as a minimal pair of a 15 cm sentence.
